formulations.Polymer system Notes: Poly(acrylonitrile-co-butyl acrylate) with 67 mol% AN (AN:BuA = 2:1), made by radical polymerization with AIBN in acetonitrile at 70 °C. Polymer-in-salt electrolyte: LiTFSI to AN m.u. molar ratio 1.2 (~75 wt%, 74.6 wt% in the SEM sample). Amorphous by DSC, with no melting up to 200 °C. Forms transparent, flexible membranes. SEM shows crystalline salt islands on the film surface. This composition gives the conductivity maximum in the LiTFSI concentration series.
formulations.Transference notes: Polarization (10 mV) with impedance before/after, Bruce-Vincent/Evans-type method, Li electrodes. t+ = 0.67 at 65 °C and 0.48 at 85 °C.
formulations.VFT Notes (above temp): VTF form sigma = sigma0 T^-0.5 exp[-B/(T-T0)]; fitted to second-heating-cycle conductivity data; T0 = 182 K. Table 5 also gives Tg (DSC) = 250 K, log sigma at Tg = -11.1, log decoupling index R_tau = 3.3.

formulations.Notes: The paper states conductivity on the order of 1e-7 S/cm at 20 °C and 1e-5 S/cm at 60 °C. Conductivity points are plot values from Fig. 3 (1000/T converted to °C). Rsei with Li electrodes at 70 °C was 280-300 ohm cm2 over 320 h. FTIR nu(CN) bands at 2236 and 2252 cm-1.

Highest conductivity of the salts tested (~1e-4 S/cm), weakly temperature dependent. Estimated log R_tau ~11 if Tg = 49 C. Conductivity read from the Figure 2 plot.
